visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with brown, shoulder-length hair and bangs is the central character, wearing a cream-colored, long-sleeved knitted top under a black spaghetti-strap dress. She sits on a gray cushion in a brightly lit, minimalist indoor living room with a wooden dining table and white walls in the background; she speaks energetically while gesturing with both hands. (2) A transition shows a flat-lay view of several gray and white packaged items from the brand '3 coins' arranged on a light-colored wooden floor, accompanied by white animated heart icons and text overlays indicating a shopping list. (3) The woman is shown in a mirror selfie within a retail store environment (3 coins), holding a white shopping basket and wearing a beige puffer jacket and a patterned scarf; the store background is filled with neatly organized shelves of kitchenware and lifestyle products. (4) Back in the living room, the woman holds up two slim, white rectangular boxes labeled 'Electric Grinder Slim' and proceeds to unbox one, showing a sleek white cylindrical device with a transparent bottom section filled with peppercorns. She demonstrates the device's button placement and shows it grinding spices onto a white ceramic plate in a modern kitchen setting with glass oil dispensers. (5) She then introduces 'Stock Bag L' by holding its white box, tearing the top perforation, and pulling out a transparent plastic storage bag with a double-seal zipper and a white memo area. The lighting is consistently bright and natural, highlighting the textures of the plastic and the woman's manicured nails. (6) The woman holds up two plastic-wrapped sets of beige and white waffle-textured kitchen cloths, then displays a large white foldable shopping bag with gray straps, even putting it over her shoulder to demonstrate its size and functionality in front of the living room background. (7) She presents packages of 'Hair Drying Caps' in gray and beige tones, unboxing one to reveal a soft, fluffy microfiber texture, and then shows a small gray tote bag with a white tag, demonstrating its eye-level scale. (8) The video concludes with the woman sitting in the original living room spot, summarizing her thoughts with enthusiastic hand gestures as a montage of all the featured items briefly appears on the floor beside her.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-arousal female voice speaking Mandarin at a fast pace, accompanied by an upbeat, major-key acoustic guitar BGM with a steady pop beat. The tone is consistently friendly and welcoming, with the speaker articulating clearly to introduce the vlog concept. (2) As the product showcase starts, distinct foley sounds are heard, specifically the crisp, high-frequency rustling of plastic bags and the tearing of paper packaging, indicating the physical unboxing process. The BGM continues at a moderate volume beneath the voice. (3) A new phase is triggered by the mechanical, low-frequency buzzing sound of the electric grinder operating, mixed with the sharp, percussive sound of peppercorns hitting a ceramic plate. The female speaker’s pitch rises slightly as she expresses excitement about the product's efficiency. (4) The audio transitions through multiple segments of packaging rustle and fabric friction as the speaker handles the kitchen cloths and the large bag. Each new item is introduced with a slight vocal swell and clear enunciated titles of the products being handled. (5) The final phase features a return to the continuous narration as the speaker provides a concluding summary. A subtle whoosh-like transition SFX marks the final shot, and the music swells briefly before fading out in sync with the speech ending.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to provide a helpful and enthusiastic review of home lifestyle and kitchen products purchased from the Japanese brand '3 coins'. By demonstrating each item's practical use and aesthetic value, the creator seeks to inform her audience about budget-friendly yet stylish shopping options.
